original_value: High-capacity internal solid-state storage drive built for fast boot times, responsive application loading, and reliable everyday use. Features PCIe 4.0 NVMe connectivity, low-power operation, and a compact M.2 2280 form factor for desktops and laptops.

result.paraphrase: Compact M.2 2280 internal SSD designed for desktops and laptops, offering high-capacity storage, fast boot times, responsive app loading, dependable everyday use, PCIe 4.0 NVMe connectivity, and low-power operation.
